# Cotopaxi

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `cotopaxi` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 13 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: cotopaxi.

Cotopaxi is a public outdoor shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.cotopaxi.com](https://www.cotopaxi.com) on 2026-11-22. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, All Packs, one public product, and About Us were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

`catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The favicon is 32 px, scaled to 128 px with nearest neighbour, so the icon edges are the site's own pixels, repeated. Font files were not downloaded. Gotham and Mont were loaded in the page. The style guide falls back to Helvetica. Bootstrap radius tokens are `0px`. The search pill is the exception, at `99px`.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page white and the announcement lilac.** The page is `#ffffff`. The promo bar is `#ebdbff`, 34px. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Use a square white shop button.** Shop Packs is 41px, radius `0px`, uppercase, letter-spacing `1.5px`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Leave Black Friday and Gifts as the coloured departments.** Black Friday is `#8a0010`. Gifts is `#005f9e`. The others are ink. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Stop before account, cart, and checkout.** Those controls were mapped and not opened. [site-tree.md](site-tree.md)
